verdict.rationale: Motion's docs show adjacent availability controls. Users can create custom time windows that tasks are slotted into, set daily meeting limits that make the calendar unbookable once reached, and share a booking embed with ideal time slots. None of these explicitly describes defining working-hours schedules. Missing for 10: explicit working-hours schedule definition, date-specific overrides, out-of-office periods, detailed availability docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
